scope: Independent review of explicitly owner-authorized four-listener HTTP risk capability in the short-lived CLI gate
checks: Exactly four immutable IDs map to the javascript/HttpToHttps rule and approved listener paths; all other findings remain blocked.
Full fingerprints, complete flow digest, primary source and every context hash remain mandatory after risk classification.
Acceptance record SHA-256 is pinned; unauthorized text changes or date extension fail before a capability is issued.
Existing record policy checks maximum 30-day lifetime and minimum 24-hour remaining validity; CLI reloads the record with current time on every invocation.
Module-private WeakSet rejects forged capability objects. Owner-accepted risks count separately from false positives; original independent open dispositions remain unchanged.
limitations: No live deployment or TLS remediation was performed or certified.

The exported testable loader accepts an injected clock and capabilities are process-local; the reviewed production CLI creates and consumes them within one invocation. Test title reused after expiration covers reloading an expired record, not indefinite reuse in a persistent embedding.
